description: This file defines composable UI components for tabs in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes the implementation of custom tab and tab row components (`NiaTab` and `NiaTabRow`) built on top of Material 3 components, along with preview functions for design, and some theme-related objects.

classes.name: NiaTabDefaults
classes.description: Object holding default styling parameters for tabs, such as top padding.

methods.name: NiaTab
methods.description: A custom composable wrapping Material3 [Tab], shifting the text label down with specific styling.

methods.name: NiaTabRow
methods.description: A custom composable wrapping Material3 [TabRow], providing a customized indicator and theme.

methods.name: TabsPreview
methods.description: A composable preview function demonstrating how the tab row looks with sample titles.
